SELECT COMMONCODE AS commonCode, COMMONCODE_NUMBER AS commonCodeNumber, JOINT_CODE_GROUP_NAME AS groupName, CODENAME_1 AS itemName, CODENAME_2 AS itemDetail, UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, COVERAGE_YN AS coverageYn, DURATION_MIN AS durationMin FROM COMMONCODE
COMMONCODE IN ('M', 'P')
AND COMMONCODE = 'M'
AND COMMONCODE = 'P'
AND ( CODENAME_1 LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CODENAME_2 LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR JOINT_CODE_GROUP_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY COMMONCODE, COMMONCODE_NUMBER
